units.source_text: 但是，炉灶没有拆掉（大部分人家都保留着），

en.t: However, the cooking stoves had not been removed (most households kept them),

units.source_text: 也许是普遍信奉灶神—灶王爷的缘故吧。

en.t: perhaps because people generally believed in the stove god, the Stove King.

units.source_text: 各家的炉灶后面都供着镇火的神符，而且还排着布袋神 [3] 。

en.t: Behind every household stove there was a sacred talisman to ward off fire, and figures of Hotei were also lined up there [3].

units.source_text: 布袋神共有七尊，每年初午 [4] 人们都到伏见的稻荷神社请一尊回来供上，

en.t: There were seven Hotei figures in all; every year on the first Day of the Horse [4], people went to the Inari Shrine at Fushimi to bring back one figure and enshrine it,
and afterward they bought and added the others one by one.

units.source_text: 如果在这期间家里死了人，就又从第一尊开始，再逐尊请来。

en.t: If someone in the household died during that time, they would start again from the first figure and bring them in one by one all over again.
